title: Grid mode for map tokens
summary: DMs can switch a map's grid mode on and off, and line tokens up with the grid in one step when they turn it on.
items: Grid mode (in Layers and the Inspector) snaps tokens to squares for everyone and draws the grid lines. Turning it off lets tokens move freely and never moves a token.

Turning grid mode on with tokens between squares asks how to line them up: snap them to the nearest squares (recommended, one action with Undo) or shift the grid under them so they stay exactly where they are.
Just turn it on leaves tokens where they are.
Maps without a grid can get an automatic hidden grid in one tap from the Combat token tool, so you can place tokens anywhere and show the grid later.
The map title now shows its place (for example the city it belongs to).
